findings.claim: The repository's agent-facing ai-cli skill does not document the new video resolution capability.
findings.evidence: skills/ai-cli/SKILL.md is the durable invocation guide for agents, but it contains no --resolution flag or resolution example. The prior cross-command --timeout feature explicitly updated this skill.

issue_candidates.title: Validate generation options before Gateway model discovery
issue_candidates.evidence: videoGenerationOptions is called after fetchGatewayModels, matching existing count, aspect-ratio, and duration ordering, so local input errors can wait on remote discovery.
